policies.title: SIM registration and ownership
policies.guidance: A SIM is tied to its registered owner. Only the owner, or someone with verified consent, can request changes.

policies.title: Identity verification before changes
policies.guidance: Identity is verified before any SIM or account change. Nova does not perform sensitive changes inside chat.

policies.title: SIM activation help
policies.guidance: If a new SIM is not active, share the number and when you got it; guidance and a complaint are available if it stays inactive.

policies.title: Replacement or duplicate SIM
policies.guidance: Replacement is handled through verified channels with the registered owner's identity documents.

policies.title: Lost or stolen SIM
policies.guidance: Report it as soon as possible so the number can be blocked. This is treated as a priority case and reviewed by a human.

policies.title: Snatched phone with SIM inside
policies.guidance: Report immediately; a priority complaint is created and staff review it. Follow local police reporting advice.

policies.title: Account access problems
policies.guidance: For login problems use the reset options in the app. Nova never asks for your password or OTP.

policies.title: Changing account contact details
policies.guidance: Contact detail changes require verification and may be routed to an agent.

policies.title: Multiple SIMs on one identity
policies.guidance: Questions about SIMs linked to your identity are checked by staff, not answered from chat.

policies.title: Someone else's SIM or account
policies.guidance: Requests about another person's SIM or account are declined unless authorisation is verified.

policies.title: Slow internet basics
policies.guidance: Check data balance, signal, airplane mode toggle and a restart before raising a complaint.

policies.title: Internet not working after recharge
policies.guidance: Confirm the package is active in the app and note the time; if it is not, a complaint is created.

policies.title: Data balance questions
policies.guidance: Balance shown in the app is the reference. Report mismatches with a screenshot and time.

policies.title: APN and data settings
policies.guidance: Confirm mobile data is on and settings are default. Reset network settings only if you are comfortable doing so.

policies.title: Fair usage limits
policies.guidance: Packages follow the fair-usage terms shown at purchase; check the package details before buying.

policies.title: Data disappearing quickly
policies.guidance: Review background apps and auto-updates; if usage looks wrong, raise a billing or usage complaint.

policies.title: Social media apps not loading
policies.guidance: Test another app and network to isolate the issue; report with the app name and time.

policies.title: Hotspot and tethering
policies.guidance: Hotspot use draws from the same package. Check the package terms for any limits.

policies.title: Data package activation delays
policies.guidance: Wait a short while, restart the phone, and check the app; then report the order reference.

policies.title: Speed complaints
policies.guidance: Include location, time, and a speed test result so the technical team can investigate.

policies.title: Cannot make calls
policies.guidance: Check balance, package validity and signal, then restart. Report the number you tried and the time.

policies.title: Cannot receive calls
policies.guidance: Check call forwarding and do-not-disturb settings on the phone first.

policies.title: Dropped or poor quality calls
policies.guidance: Note locations and times; repeated drops in one area are logged for the technical team.

policies.title: SMS not sending
policies.guidance: Check balance, the message centre setting and the recipient number; then report it.

policies.title: SMS not receiving
policies.guidance: Check storage on the phone and blocked-sender settings before reporting.

policies.title: Unknown or unwanted calls
policies.guidance: Do not share personal details. Report repeated unwanted calls with numbers and times.

policies.title: Suspicious SMS or links
policies.guidance: Do not click links or reply. Report it; the case is reviewed as a potential fraud attempt.

policies.title: Call charges questions
policies.guidance: Charges are checked against your package terms and records; a complaint is opened for disputes.

policies.title: Minutes bundle usage
policies.guidance: Bundle usage can be viewed in the app. Report mismatches with the date and time.

policies.title: Call forwarding and waiting
policies.guidance: These are phone or network settings you can toggle; ask Nova for general steps.

policies.title: No signal
policies.guidance: Restart, reseat the SIM, and try another location; then report your area and time.

policies.title: Weak signal indoors
policies.guidance: Signal can drop indoors; report the address area so the pattern can be reviewed.

policies.title: Area-wide outage reports
policies.guidance: Multiple reports from one area are grouped and passed to the technical team.

policies.title: Network mode settings
policies.guidance: Switching between automatic and preferred network modes can help; steps vary by phone.

policies.title: Coverage questions before buying
policies.guidance: Coverage varies by location. Nova gives general guidance and does not promise coverage at a specific spot.

policies.title: Network problems while travelling
policies.guidance: Note the route and time; mobile coverage may vary along the way.

policies.title: Tower or site complaints
policies.guidance: Site and tower concerns are logged as complaints and reviewed by the technical team.

policies.title: Emergency services access
policies.guidance: In an emergency contact local emergency services directly; do not rely on chat.

policies.title: Repeated network complaints
policies.guidance: Repeated issues in the same area are linked so the team sees the pattern.

policies.title: Planned maintenance notices
policies.guidance: Maintenance notices appear in the app when available; check there first.

policies.title: Recharge not reflected
policies.guidance: Keep the transaction reference ready; a complaint is created and verified against records.

policies.title: Wrong balance deduction
policies.guidance: Report with date, amount and what you were doing; the charge is verified before any correction.

policies.title: Refund requests
policies.guidance: Refunds are reviewed against records. Approved corrections are applied as per the approved policy.

policies.title: Duplicate charge
policies.guidance: Provide both transaction references; staff verify and respond through your complaint.

policies.title: Unknown deduction
policies.guidance: Check active packages and subscriptions first, then report the amount and time.

policies.title: Loan or credit balance questions
policies.guidance: Ask Nova for general information; account-specific balances are shown in the app.

policies.title: Bill or statement questions
policies.guidance: Statements are provided through the app or official channels, not through chat text.

policies.title: Payment method problems
policies.guidance: Never share a full card or bank number in chat. Use the official payment flow.

policies.title: Advance or top-up mistakes
policies.guidance: Wrong-number top-ups are reviewed case by case; report the details promptly.

policies.title: Tax and charge explanations
policies.guidance: Nova gives general information only; official charge breakdowns come from official documents.

policies.title: Choosing a package
policies.guidance: Compare data, minutes, SMS and validity in the Packages page before ordering.

policies.title: Package activation
policies.guidance: After ordering, check the app for the active package; report if it is not active.

policies.title: Package validity and expiry
policies.guidance: Validity is shown at purchase. Check the app for current status.

policies.title: Auto-renewal
policies.guidance: Check package details and settings for renewal behaviour; ask Nova to explain general options.

policies.title: Unsubscribing from a package
policies.guidance: Use the options in the app; if unavailable, raise a request for an agent.

policies.title: Package price disputes
policies.guidance: Disputes are compared with the price shown at purchase and handled as a billing complaint.

policies.title: Offer eligibility
policies.guidance: Eligibility follows the offer terms. Nova does not promise an offer that is not listed.

policies.title: Bundled subscriptions
policies.guidance: Bundled perks depend on the plan. Check plan details before ordering.

policies.title: Changing plans
policies.guidance: Plan changes follow the approved terms; check the app or ask Nova for general steps.

policies.title: Group and family plans
policies.guidance: Group plans require the plan owner's authorisation for changes.

policies.title: Using the SIM abroad
policies.guidance: Roaming availability depends on the plan and destination. Check plan details before travelling.

policies.title: Roaming activation
policies.guidance: Activation options are in the app or through an agent; do not assume it is enabled by default.

policies.title: No service while roaming
policies.guidance: Check roaming is enabled and try selecting a partner network manually; then report it.

policies.title: Roaming charge questions
policies.guidance: Charges follow the terms in place at the time; disputes are checked by staff.

policies.title: Data roaming safety
policies.guidance: Turn off background data if you want to control usage while travelling.

policies.title: Returning from abroad
policies.guidance: Turn off roaming settings on your phone if not needed and restart to reconnect.

policies.title: Lost phone while travelling
policies.guidance: Report immediately so the SIM can be blocked; a priority case is created.

policies.title: International calls and SMS
policies.guidance: Rates depend on the plan and destination. Nova does not quote unlisted rates.

policies.title: Wi-Fi calling and messaging apps
policies.guidance: Availability depends on the device and plan; check the plan details.

policies.title: Roaming complaints
policies.guidance: Include country, dates and what happened so staff can review your case.

policies.title: Porting a number in
policies.guidance: Porting follows the official process with identity verification; start it from the app or through an agent.

policies.title: Porting a number out
policies.guidance: Port-out requests are handled through verified channels and may need staff review.

policies.title: Port-in status questions
policies.guidance: Check the status in the app; unresolved delays can be raised as a complaint.

policies.title: Documents for porting
policies.guidance: Identity documents of the registered owner are typically required, as per the approved process.

policies.title: Porting a number you do not own
policies.guidance: Requests for someone else's number are declined unless authorised and verified.

policies.title: Number retained after porting
policies.guidance: Your number is kept as part of a completed port; report if it behaves unexpectedly.

policies.title: Service interruptions during porting
policies.guidance: Short interruptions can occur while a port completes; report long ones.

policies.title: Cancelling a port request
policies.guidance: Cancellation is handled through the same channel used to place it.

policies.title: Port complaints
policies.guidance: Provide the request reference and dates; the case is routed to the right team.

policies.title: Unauthorised port suspected
policies.guidance: Report immediately. This is a security-sensitive case reviewed by a human.

policies.title: OTP, PIN and password safety
policies.guidance: PakSim staff and Nova never ask for OTPs, PINs or passwords. Never share them.

policies.title: Phishing and fake messages
policies.guidance: Ignore links and do not reply. Report the message so it can be reviewed.

policies.title: Fake agent or caller
policies.guidance: If a caller asks for private details, end the call and report it.

policies.title: Unauthorised activity on your number
policies.guidance: Report immediately with details; the case is prioritised and reviewed by a human.

policies.title: SIM swap concerns
policies.guidance: Report sudden loss of service you did not cause. Staff investigate as a security case.

policies.title: Account takeover
policies.guidance: Change your password, report the issue, and expect verification before changes.

policies.title: Fraudulent charges
policies.guidance: Report with dates and amounts; staff verify against records.

policies.title: Suspicious apps or links
policies.guidance: Install apps only from official stores and avoid unknown links.

policies.title: Reporting a scam
policies.guidance: Give what you know without sharing secrets; a fraud case is opened for review.

policies.title: Staying safe online
policies.guidance: Use strong unique passwords and keep your phone updated.

policies.title: Temporary SIM block
policies.guidance: A temporary block protects the number while a case is reviewed.

policies.title: Unblocking a SIM
policies.guidance: Unblocking requires verification and may be done by staff after review.

policies.title: SIM blocked unexpectedly
policies.guidance: Report your number and what happened; staff review why it was blocked.

policies.title: Blocked after loss or theft
policies.guidance: Recovery follows the approved process with identity verification.

policies.title: Recovering a number
policies.guidance: Recovery depends on verification and the case; staff will guide next steps.

policies.title: Block due to security review
policies.guidance: Some blocks are precautionary; staff explain what is needed to lift them.

policies.title: Checking block status
policies.guidance: Status is shown in your case; ask Nova for a general explanation.

policies.title: Multiple block requests
policies.guidance: Repeated requests are linked to your existing case.

policies.title: Blocking on someone else's behalf
policies.guidance: Requests for another person's SIM require verified authorisation.

policies.title: Delays in unblocking
policies.guidance: Raise it through your complaint reference so it can be followed up.

policies.title: Restart and airplane mode steps
policies.guidance: Toggle airplane mode for a short time and restart before reporting an issue.

policies.title: SIM reseating
policies.guidance: Power off, remove and reinsert the SIM gently, then power on.

policies.title: Software updates
policies.guidance: Keeping the phone updated can fix network and app problems.

policies.title: Resetting network settings
policies.guidance: This clears saved networks; use it only if you are comfortable.

policies.title: Testing with another phone
policies.guidance: Trying the SIM in another compatible phone helps isolate the fault.

policies.title: Checking mobile data toggles
policies.guidance: Make sure mobile data and the right SIM slot are enabled.

policies.title: Battery saver effects
policies.guidance: Battery saver can limit background data and notifications.

policies.title: App-specific issues
policies.guidance: Clear the app cache or reinstall it before blaming the network.

policies.title: What to include in a report
policies.guidance: Give the number, time, location and steps already tried.

policies.title: When Nova will create a complaint
policies.guidance: If steps do not work or the issue needs staff, Nova creates a trackable complaint.

policies.title: Filing a complaint
policies.guidance: Describe your issue in your own words; Nova helps create a complaint when needed.

policies.title: Tracking a complaint
policies.guidance: Use the Track page or your complaint number to see status and timeline.

policies.title: Complaint priority
policies.guidance: Security-sensitive and urgent cases get higher priority than routine ones.

policies.title: What agents can do
policies.guidance: Agents review complaints, request details and resolve within approved rules.

policies.title: What admins oversee
policies.guidance: Admins oversee categories, rules, audit trails and overall service quality.

policies.title: When cases escalate
policies.guidance: Cases escalate when rules require it, for example security, repeated failures or delays.

policies.title: Service level targets
policies.guidance: Each category has a target shown in the case; delays are flagged internally.

policies.title: Adding more details
policies.guidance: Reply on the complaint or in chat with more information to help resolution.

policies.title: Reopening a case
policies.guidance: If a fix did not work, say so on the complaint so it can be reviewed.

policies.title: Giving feedback
policies.guidance: Feedback on a resolution helps improve support quality.

policies.title: What data is used
policies.guidance: Data is used to provide service, verify identity and resolve complaints.

policies.title: Data sharing
policies.guidance: Data is not sold; access is limited to authorised staff and is logged.

policies.title: Sensitive details in chat
policies.guidance: Do not type OTPs, passwords or full card numbers; Nova masks sensitive patterns.

policies.title: Access to your records
policies.guidance: Record requests follow verification and approved processes.

policies.title: Call and chat history
policies.guidance: Your own chat history is visible to you in your account.

policies.title: Correcting your details
policies.guidance: Update details in your profile or raise a request for verification.

policies.title: Deleting your data
policies.guidance: Deletion requests are handled through verified channels, subject to record-keeping duties.

policies.title: Audit trails
policies.guidance: Actions on cases are recorded to keep support traceable.

policies.title: Third-party requests
policies.guidance: Requests from other people about your data are not answered without authorisation.

policies.title: Privacy questions to Nova
policies.guidance: Nova gives general privacy information and escalates account-specific requests.

policies.title: What Nova can help with
policies.guidance: Nova gives guidance from approved policies and helps create complaints.

policies.title: Languages Nova understands
policies.guidance: English, Urdu, Roman Urdu and Sindhi are supported for chat.

policies.title: Answers come from approved knowledge
policies.guidance: Nova answers using approved knowledge and rules and does not invent policy.

policies.title: When Nova does not know
policies.guidance: If a request is unsupported, Nova says so and offers a human follow-up.

policies.title: Sensitive requests
policies.guidance: Requests involving identity, security or money changes are escalated rather than handled in chat.

policies.title: Nova never asks for secrets
policies.guidance: Nova will never ask for OTPs, PINs or passwords.

policies.title: Human oversight
policies.guidance: Humans review escalated cases, and admins can update rules.

policies.title: Voice input
policies.guidance: Voice input is available where your device supports it.

policies.title: Nova and complaints
policies.guidance: Nova can create a trackable complaint when self-help is not enough.

policies.title: Limits of AI answers
policies.guidance: Nova gives general support guidance, not legal, financial or account-specific promises.
